title: The Szekeres–Wilf bound on chromatic number
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph. For an induced subgraph $H$ of $G$, write $\delta(H)$ for its minimum degree (the least number of neighbours of any vertex of $H$). Then the chromatic number of $G$ satisfies
\[
\chi(G) \le 1 + \max_{H} \delta(H),
\]
where the maximum is taken over all induced subgraphs $H$ of $G$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
